passage.label: swear what see what not see; indeed Quran word noble Messenger; not word poet little believe; nor word soothsayer little remember; revelation Lord worlds; if Muhammad made up about Us false sayings seized right hand cut aorta none prevent Us from him

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنٖۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ

mainSubject.label: Oath by both the seen and the unseen establishing the Quran as the word of a noble Messenger, neither a poet's word met with little belief nor a soothsayer's word met with little remembrance, but a revelation from the Lord of the worlds; the counterfactual guarantee that had Muhammad fabricated sayings against Allah he would have been seized by the right hand and his aorta cut with none able to prevent it

Then his aorta would have been cut

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the flood-reminder and conscious-ear statement (12) before the Horn blast opens (13); P2 ends with the wound-discharge food verdict (37) before the seen-unseen oath begins (38); P3 runs through the Messenger-word affirmation, the poet-soothsayer denials and the fabrication counterfactual (38-47); P4 covers the reminder-for-the-righteous, the regret declaration, the truth-of-certainty and the closing exaltation (48-52).
